title: TRICARE Select Outpatient Lines on the Admission Day of an Inpatient Mental Health Stay - Attending Share
content:
A **TRICARE Select** professional or outpatient line whose service date is the admission date of an inpatient mental health stay is cost-shared and paid in proportion to the stay's authorized days, as the patient's Inpatient Mental Health Authorization in Referrals and Authorizations shows them.

**Adjudication rule.** Where the corrected outpatient line's service date is the admission date of an inpatient mental health stay on the enrollment and an approved Inpatient Mental Health Authorization starting that day authorizes fewer days than the stay billed, the attending share is the authorized days divided by the billed days of the stay, read from the reversal of that stay's earlier adjudication or, where the stay was never reversed, from its posted line; where such a stay billed days and no approved Inpatient Mental Health Authorization starting that day is on file, the attending share is zero; otherwise the attending share is one. The amount a corrected outpatient line is cost-shared on is the amount left to cost-share times the attending share, rounded to the cent. What TRICARE would pay as primary payer on a corrected outpatient line is the allowed amount times the attending share, less the beneficiary liability, never below zero.

## Records read

- **TRICARE Select claim lines of the enrollment:** an inpatient mental health stay whose admission date is the line's service date, and its billed inpatient days - from the reversal of the stay's earlier adjudication, or from its posted line where it was never reversed.
- **Referrals and Authorizations:** the patient's Inpatient Mental Health Authorization starting on that admission date - its status (approved) and the days it authorizes.

## Judgement table

| Inpatient mental health stay admitted on the service date | Approved Inpatient Mental Health Authorization starting that day | Attending share |
|---|---|---|
| yes, billed days more than the authorized days | yes | authorized days divided by billed days |
| yes, billed days not more than the authorized days | yes | one |
| yes, with billed days | no | zero |
| no such stay | - | one |

## Hypothetical figures

A stay billed for 10 days with an approved authorization for 6 days gives an attending share of 6 divided by 10, that is 0.6: on 500.00 left to cost-share the line is cost-shared on 300.00, and an allowed amount of 500.00 counts as 300.00 for the primary payment. With an authorization for 10 or 12 days the share is one. With no approved authorization starting on the admission date the share is zero, and the line is cost-shared on 0.00.
